responsibility: Provides the rs6000 DFA scheduling model for IBM POWER8. It captures the wider dispatch group structure, separate fixed-point and load/store subresources, VSU execution, branch placement, and a large set of bypass relationships for integer, compare, multiply, FP, vector, crypto, and memory operations, making it the scheduler description that distinguishes POWER8’s fusion-capable issue model from POWER7 and POWER9.
